children.prompt: A blue marlin has a girth of 72 inches and a length of 156 inches. Could it weigh over 1000 pounds?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}w&=\frac{Lg^{2}}{800}\\w&=\frac{156\times72^{2}}{800}\\w&=\frac{156\times5184}{800}\\w&=\frac{808704}{800}\\w&=1010.88\end{align*}$$

Since $1010.88>1000$, yes, the marlin could weigh over 1000 pounds.

children.label: b
children.prompt: A swordfish is 120 inches in length and weighs 175 pounds. Estimate its girth to 2 d.p.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}w&=\frac{Lg^{2}}{800}\\175&=\frac{120g^{2}}{800}\\175\times800&=120g^{2}\\140000&=120g^{2}\\g^{2}&=\frac{140000}{120}\\g^{2}&=\frac{3500}{3}\\g&=\sqrt{\frac{3500}{3}}\\g&\approx34.16\end{align*}$$

Girth is a length, so take the positive square root. The girth is about 34.16 inches.
